answer: The nadir holds work receipts rather than names, so the dune of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime, idle agents bleed standing. By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
